name: Corrupted Treant
body:
CORRUPTED TREANT
CR 8

XP 4,800
NE Huge plant
Init –1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 7, flat-footed 21 (–1 Dex, +14 natural, –2 size)
hp 104 (12d8+48)
Fort +12, Ref +3, Will +9
Defensive Abilities plant traits, negative energy affinity
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 slams +17 (2d6+7/19–20)
Ranged rock +7 (2d6+10)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks rock throwing (180 ft.), trample (2d6+10, DC 25)

TACTICS

The corrupted treant uses a swift action to summon a negative energy storm on his first turn, then tramples or simply bludgeons his enemies to death. Animated by dark magic, he fights to the death.

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 8, Con 19, Int 12, Wis 16, Cha 13
Base Atk +9; CMB +18; CMD 27
Feats Alertness, Improved Critical (slam), Improved Sunder, Iron Will, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (slam)
Skills Diplomacy +9, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (nature) +9, Perception +12, Sense Motive +9, Stealth –9 (+7 in forests); Racial Modifiers +16 Stealth in forests
Languages Common, Sylvan, Treant
SQ double damage against objects, treespeech

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Double Damage Against Objects (Ex)

A treant or animated tree that makes a full attack against an object or structure deals double damage.

Treespeech (Ex)

A treant has the ability to converse with plants as if subject to a continual speak with plants spell, and most plants greet them with an attitude of friendly or helpful.

Negative Energy Storm (Su)

Once per day as a swift action, a corrupt treant can conjure a negative energy storm. The winds instantly grow to strong in a 100-ft. radius, and the storm grows at the start of each of the treant’s subsequent turns.

1st Round–Black rain starts pouring from the sky (concealment past 50 feet, total concealment past 100 feet).
2nd Round–The rain becomes hail, dealing 1 point of lethal damage to all creatures in the area each round while maintaining the concealment.
3th Round–As a swift action, the corrupted treant may call a red, negatively-charged lightning strike on any creature within 100 feet (including the treant itself). The bolt deals 4d6 points of negative energy damage, and deafens all creatures within 10 feet of impact for one minute (DC 17 Reflex halves the damage, DC 17 Fort negates deafness). This save is Charisma–based.

The thunderstorm abates after 1d6 minutes, or instantly if the corrupt treant is reduced to negative hit points. If reduced to negative hit points, a corrupt treant falls unconscious but is still corrupted.
